items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: Like I said, Buddy Rich, he would come out, he would sit in.

ctx.x: Really something. Well, did any of these guys come out and sit in with your band?

Oh, yeah, all of them did. Like I said, Buddy Rich, he would come out, he would sit in. Anybody that ever come out there, they set in. Art Blakey -- the only guy that I regret never did sit in, but he came to the club, and this was such a great thing for me, this is when I was saying about the Delésa was on the other side of the street.
